title: 好友信息
problem_statement_md:
程序员小明编写了一个程序，声明了一些变量来保存好友人数据，然后输出。
然而，数据类型是错误的，所以程序不能工作。

请修改变量的数据类型，修复bug，使其与给定值一起工作。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Contact Card[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Your friend created a program that declares a number of variables to hold contact data and then outputs them.
However, the data types are wrong so the program does not work.
Fix the code by changing the data types of the variables to work with their given values. 
[note]Look at the values that are assigned to the variables to understand what type they should have.[/note]
hint_md: 观察下分配给变量的值，猜测它们应该是什么数据类型。

code_templates.template:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    var city bool = "成都"
    var country int = "北京" 
    var age string = 24
    var height bool = 1.91
    
    fmt.Println("COUNTRY:")
    fmt.Println(country)
    fmt.Println("CITY:")
    fmt.Println(city)
    fmt.Println("AGE:")
    fmt.Println(age)
    fmt.Println("HEIGHT")
    fmt.Println(height)
}
code_templates.solution_code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
    var city string = "成都"
    var country string = "北京"
    var age int = 24
    var height float32 = 1.91

    fmt.Println("COUNTRY:")
    fmt.Println(country)
    fmt.Println("CITY:")
    fmt.Println(city)
    fmt.Println("AGE:")
    fmt.Println(age)
    fmt.Println("HEIGHT")
    fmt.Println(height)
}
